newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Two dead, 43 escape in Brazil jailbreak.
newsitem.headline: Two dead, 43 escape in Brazil jailbreak.

text.p: One police officer and one prisoner died and 43 prison inmates escaped during a jailbreak in the southern Brazilian state of Parana, a police spokesman said on Thursday.

He said 43 prisoners escaped from the jail in Ponta Grossa, 70 miles (115 km) northwest of the state capital Curitiba, on Wednesday evening. They shot and wounded one police officer who died later, he said.
He said police recaptured 12 escaped prisoners on Thursday, and around 110 police officers were continuing to search for the others.
Jailbreaks and prison riots are not uncommon in Brazil where jails are extremely overcrowded and conditions appalling.
